    • addNumber

      public void addNumber(double x, int mode) throws Exception
      Adds number to histogram
      Parameters:
      x - the number that's added
      mode - if mode == 1 numbers outside of [min_hist, max_hist] don't get added, if mode == 2 numbers outside of [min_hist, max_hist] get added to the ends of the histogram, if mode == 3 numbers outside of [min_hist, max_hist] change min_hist and max_hist
      Throws:
      Exception - mode == 1 and number is outside of [min_hist, max_hist]

    • addNumber
